intake_scope.user_goal: Create the final PRD for the Arboscus Teamplaner MVP.
in_scope: Worksite weather for today and the following day
Pilot acceptance scenario with at least twelve active employees and three parallel worksites
Assignment-scoped weather visibility without employee location tracking
Hourly/daypart weather, air humidity, precipitation, wind/gusts, ozone, and official warnings
Architecture, provider, retention, and pilot-metric recommendations
Post-MVP specification for internal plan/actual cost transparency and machine-rental revenue tracking.
Jira-ready future epic decomposition without adding the feature to the MVP implementation scope.
out_of_scope: Implementation of cost, revenue, rental, invoice, payroll, VAT, or accounting functionality in the MVP.
General sales, customer order, invoicing, tax, payment, or bookkeeping workflows.
missing_inputs: Final application framework and deployment topology approval
Final transactional email provider or existing corporate email integration
Legally approved retention and deletion schedule
Stakeholder-approved pilot baseline and target values
Decision whether severe-warning changes additionally trigger browser push and/or email escalation
Repository-specific lint, type-check, unit, integration, and end-to-end commands after code scaffold exists
assumptions: The approved PRD remains the product source of truth.
The canonical repository is https://github.com/DYAI2025/Arborga.git; its current default branch is master until explicitly renamed.
Supabase is selected for the database; Supabase Auth and Storage are recommended but require an ADR decision.
Weather visibility is derived from active/future assignments and worksite coordinates; no continuous employee GPS tracking is required or permitted.
Weather remains advisory in MVP and cannot automatically cancel work, block publication, or issue a binding stop-work decision.
Official warnings are sourced independently from forecast data so that provider forecasts cannot masquerade as official warnings.
ASSUMPTION: Post-MVP economics is activated only by a separately approved phase and feature flag.

definitions_and_domain_glossary.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

definitions_and_domain_glossary.statement: Published week: a released weekly plan visible to affected employees and requiring collected weekly confirmation.

definitions_and_domain_glossary.statement: Material change: a change to time, worksite, or required presence that reopens confirmation only for the changed appointment.
definitions_and_domain_glossary.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

definitions_and_domain_glossary.statement: Resource: uniquely identifiable device or vehicle with configurable attributes, availability, reservations, and damage state.
definitions_and_domain_glossary.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

definitions_and_domain_glossary.statement: Protected core status: non-deletable workflow semantic used by system logic; labels or colors may be configured but meaning remains fixed.

definitions_and_domain_glossary.statement: Audit record: append-only record of relevant state changes, actor, time, previous value, new value, and reason.
definitions_and_domain_glossary.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

definitions_and_domain_glossary.statement: Economic rate version: an individual, effective-dated net hourly or daily rate attached to one employee, subcontractor, machine, device, or vehicle; a new version replaces future applicability without overwriting historical versions.
definitions_and_domain_glossary.verification_method: Stakeholder review and mapped acceptance test

definitions_and_domain_glossary.statement: Planned cost: a non-accounting projection derived from planned assignment or resource-reservation duration and the rate version effective for that planned interval.
definitions_and_domain_glossary.verification_method: Stakeholder review and mapped acceptance test

definitions_and_domain_glossary.statement: Actual cost: a non-accounting internal value derived only from approved working time or confirmed resource usage and the rate version effective for the underlying interval.
definitions_and_domain_glossary.verification_method: Stakeholder review and mapped acceptance test

definitions_and_domain_glossary.statement: Machine-rental revenue: net internal revenue overview derived from a confirmed rental interval and the machine-specific effective rental-rate version; it is not an invoice or accounting posting.

functional_requirements.statement: Confirmation lifecycle: Initial publication requests one confirmation for the week; material later changes request confirmation only for changed appointments.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: Rejection workflow: Every employee can reject an assignment; category and free-text explanation are mandatory and visible to Administrator and Management.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: Notifications: Every relevant event produces both email and in-app notification; responses occur only inside the application.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: Global messages: Only Administrator and Management can send an organization-wide message.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: Conflict engine: Publication is blocked by overlapping assignments, approved absence, enabled capacity overflow, double-reserved resources, or blocked resources; other configured issues produce warnings.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: Capacity budget: An optional weekly hour budget can be set per employee; when active, exceeding it blocks publication unless Administrator or Management overrides with reason.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: Skills: Administrators maintain skills, assign them to employees, declare worksite skill needs, and view gaps.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: Absence workflow: Employees and planners can create absence entries; vacation requires Administrator or Management approval.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: Sickness workflow: Sickness creates immediate unavailability; coworkers see only relevant unavailability, not medical details.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: Team visibility: Employees see names and avatars of coworkers only for the same worksite and overlapping time unless their role grants broader access.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: Worksite notes: Administrator creates, edits, and deletes operational worksite notes; assigned employees can read them.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: Attachments: Worksites, resources, and damage reports accept authorized JPG, PNG, and PDF files up to 10 MB with mobile image compression.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: Resource register: Devices and vehicles are uniquely identifiable, support configurable attributes, status, availability, and worksite reservation.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: Resource impact propagation: A resource failure or block is stored centrally and flags every affected current and future worksite/reservation.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: Damage reporting: Every app user can submit a structured damage report; a heavy or safety-critical report requires at least one photo.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: Restricted device release: Only Administrator and Management can formally release a blocked or safety-critical resource, with reason and audit record.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: Time start/stop: Employees can start exactly one timer only from a planned assignment and stop it to create a time entry.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: Long-running timer: After ten hours, employee receives email and in-app confirmation prompt; the timer remains running and is visibly flagged.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: Time approval and correction: Completed entries move to pending approval; authorized roles approve, correct, or mark for clarification while preserving originals and notifying employee.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: MVP monetary boundary: time data in the MVP never produces wages, rates, fees, invoice values, VAT, gross amounts, payments, or accounting entries. Post-MVP calculations defined in FR-062 through FR-070 are implemented only in a separately approved phase.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: Navigation and travel time: Employee can open external navigation and optionally store a private personal origin for estimated travel time; coworkers cannot see it.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: Read-only offline access: Previously loaded current and upcoming assignments, worksite information, and needed contacts are readable offline with synchronization timestamp.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: Installable PWA: The responsive mobile-first application can be installed from supported browsers and used in app-like mode.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: Profile image and avatar pool: Employees can upload a profile image or choose an administrator-provided avatar; administrators can remove inappropriate images.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: PDF and print export: Authorized users export a print-ready weekly plan limited to their current visibility rights.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: Limited CSV import: Authorized users import active employees, skills, resources, and open worksites using preview and error reporting.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: Audit log: Relevant planning, authorization, absence, resource, damage, time, and configuration changes create append-only audit records.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: Four-week horizon: Planning supports a rolling four-week overview while keeping the operational week primary.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: Short-notice assignment: Assignments less than 24 hours before start can be published; missing response is visible for manual resolution.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: Reminder and escalation: Unanswered assignments trigger configurable reminder and escalation, initially after 24 hours.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: Voice note transcription: Damage reports accept voice notes; transcribed text must be shown for user review and explicit confirmation before submission.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: Worksite activity changes: Activity changes are audited and notify assigned employees; activity-only changes do not reopen attendance confirmation.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: Worksite weather visibility: A user sees weather only for a worksite to which the user has a visible assignment for today or the following day. Visibility is derived from assignment and worksite data; no employee device location or continuous GPS tracking is used. Users without a visible worksite assignment receive no worksite weather card.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Authorization and assignment-visibility acceptance tests

functional_requirements.statement: Employee lifecycle: Authorized users can create, edit, deactivate, and archive employee records. Historical assignments, time entries, approvals, damage reports, and audit records remain referentially intact.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Acceptance test and stakeholder review

functional_requirements.statement: Weather detail: For today and the following day, the app shows weather condition, temperature, relative humidity, precipitation probability, expected precipitation amount, wind speed, maximum gusts, ozone forecast, and official warning status for the worksite area. Values are displayed in units appropriate for Germany and include source and fetched-at information.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Weather contract and UI acceptance tests

functional_requirements.statement: Daypart forecast: The full day is divided into configurable dayparts (recommended default: morning 05-08, forenoon 08-11, midday 11-14, afternoon 14-18, evening 18-22, night 22-05). Dayparts overlapping the assignment are highlighted. Each daypart aggregates temperature range, humidity range, maximum precipitation probability, precipitation sum, maximum wind and gust, maximum ozone, and active warning windows.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Daypart aggregation tests and stakeholder UI review

functional_requirements.statement: Official warnings: DWD official warnings for the worksite municipality/district and directly intersecting warning area are shown prominently with official severity, validity window, event type, source, and update time. Thunderstorm, wind/gust, severe rain, heat, and UV warnings are included when available. A separate nearby/regional state may show relevant warnings outside the direct worksite warning area without presenting them as site-active.
functional_requirements.verification_method: CAP parsing, spatial matching, severity and UI tests

functional_requirements.statement: Advisory-only safety semantics: In MVP, weather and warning information is highly visible but informational. The system must not automatically cancel assignments, block publication, order work cessation, or replace Arboscus safety decisions. Any future automated threshold action requires a separate approved requirement, risk assessment, and ADR.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Negative tests proving no automatic planning or stop-work side effect

functional_requirements.statement: Ozone presentation: Ozone is displayed as forecast concentration in µg/m³, not as an official local measurement. The UI distinguishes the 120 µg/m³ health target value from the official 180 µg/m³ information threshold and 240 µg/m³ alert threshold, and does not provide medical diagnosis or individualized medical advice.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Unit, threshold-label, source and accessibility tests

functional_requirements.statement: Post-MVP scope gate: Planning Economics and Machine Rental is documented for backlog/Jira but must not be implemented, enabled, or included in the MVP release Definition of Done. Activation requires a separate approved phase, migration plan, permission review, and feature flag.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Stakeholder review and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: Economics authorization: Initially only Administrator and Management can view or manage rates, planned costs, actual costs, machine-rental revenue, reports, or exports. Employees receive no access. Future role expansion uses explicit server-enforced atomic permissions.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Stakeholder review and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: Individual rates: Each employee, subcontractor, machine, device, or vehicle may have its own net hourly or daily cost rate. Rentable machines may additionally have an individual net hourly or daily rental-revenue rate. Role/type default rates are not required.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Stakeholder review and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: Effective-dated history: Rates have valid-from and optional valid-to dates. A future change creates a new version and never overwrites historical use. Backdated corrections require explicit authorization, reason, impact preview, audit, and controlled recalculation.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Stakeholder review and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: Planned costs: The system may calculate planned personnel/subcontractor costs from assignment duration and planned resource costs from reservation duration using the rate version effective for the planned interval.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Stakeholder review and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: Actual costs: Personnel and subcontractor actual costs are derived only from approved time entries. Resource actual costs are derived only from confirmed usage/rental intervals. Pending, rejected, or unapproved facts do not enter actual-cost totals.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Stakeholder review and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: Machine-rental revenue: For the machine-rental domain only, a confirmed rental interval produces a net revenue value using the machine-specific effective rental rate. Other revenue categories remain out of scope and belong to accounting or another system of record.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Stakeholder review and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: Economics reporting and audit: Authorized users can compare planned cost, actual cost, and machine-rental revenue by person, resource, worksite, day, week, and selected period. Every rate change, backdated correction, calculation version, and export is audited; historical reports retain the applied rate-version reference.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Stakeholder review and mapped acceptance test

functional_requirements.statement: Net and accounting boundary: All economics values are stored and displayed as net amounts in EUR. The module does not calculate VAT, gross values, wages, salaries, invoices, payments, receivables, ledger entries, or tax obligations.
functional_requirements.verification_method: Stakeholder review and mapped acceptance test

non_functional_requirements.statement: Mobile-first usability: Primary operational journeys must work on smartphones with large touch targets and no precision clicking.
non_functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

non_functional_requirements.statement: Immediate orientation: The first viewport shows current/next assignment, time, worksite, confirmation state, and one clear primary action.
non_functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

non_functional_requirements.statement: Interaction economy: Common employee actions require minimal steps; unnecessary dropdowns and hidden menus are prohibited.
non_functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

non_functional_requirements.statement: Accessible status communication: Color is always supplemented by text, icon, initials, or pattern; contrast and font sizes support outdoor use and color-vision differences.
non_functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

non_functional_requirements.statement: Performance: On a supported mobile device and normal mobile connection, cached shell loads promptly and primary worksite/weekly views should reach interactive state within a target agreed during technical planning.
non_functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

non_functional_requirements.statement: Reliability: Publishing, confirmations, time entries, damage reports, and resource blocks must be transactionally consistent and idempotent.
non_functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

non_functional_requirements.statement: Browser support: Support current Safari and Chrome on iOS/Android and current Chrome, Edge, and Safari on desktop.
non_functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

non_functional_requirements.statement: Security: Authentication, authorization, session revocation, upload protection, and audit logging are mandatory before pilot with real data.
non_functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

non_functional_requirements.statement: Privacy: Collect only necessary employee, absence, route-origin, time, and damage data; no continuous tracking.
non_functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

non_functional_requirements.statement: Maintainability: Domain logic, UI, persistence, background jobs, and vendor adapters remain separated and testable.
non_functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

non_functional_requirements.statement: Configurability boundary: Administrators can change approved catalogs, fields, labels, and permissions without altering protected core objects or workflow semantics.
non_functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

non_functional_requirements.statement: Backup and recovery: Daily backups and a tested restore procedure are required before production.
non_functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

non_functional_requirements.statement: Offline transparency: Offline data is read-only and clearly shows last synchronization time and stale state.
non_functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

non_functional_requirements.statement: Auditability: Sensitive state changes must preserve actor, timestamp, old value, new value, and required reason.
non_functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

non_functional_requirements.statement: Scalability: No fixed technical limit is tied to the current employee or worksite count.
non_functional_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

non_functional_requirements.statement: Weather freshness and resilience: Weather responses are cached for a configurable bounded period, show fetched-at time and provider attribution where required, never fabricate missing values, and degrade to a clearly marked last-known or unavailable state.

Pilot-load acceptance: The pilot test dataset includes at least twelve active employees and three parallel worksites without treating these values as technical maxima. Core week planning remains correct and usable at that load.

Weather refresh and call economy: Forecast and air-quality data are cached once per normalized worksite coordinate, never per employee. Recommended default is refresh before first daily use and at most every three hours while a current or next-day assignment exists; ozone may refresh every six hours. Official DWD warning data is polled centrally at most every ten minutes. Forecast older than six hours and warnings older than twenty minutes are marked stale.
non_functional_requirements.verification_method: Load, cache, quota, stale-state and scheduler tests

non_functional_requirements.statement: Warning accessibility: Warning severity is not communicated by color alone. DWD level, event label, icon, validity, plain-language risk text, and source are visible. DWD severity colors remain yellow/orange/red/violet; red is reserved for official level-3 severe-weather warnings and violet for level 4.

data_model_and_core_entities.statement: Permission: Stable code, plain-language description, sensitivity level, and domain scope.
data_model_and_core_entities.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

data_model_and_core_entities.statement: Employee: Name, avatar/profile image, contact data, employment metadata, skills, weekly capacity, private origin reference, status.
data_model_and_core_entities.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

data_model_and_core_entities.statement: Worksite: Name, identifier, address, coordinates/link, color, period, status, activities, briefing, tasks, notes, safety/access data.
data_model_and_core_entities.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

data_model_and_core_entities.statement: ActivityType: Checkbox label, info description, active state, sort order, historical preservation.
data_model_and_core_entities.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

data_model_and_core_entities.statement: Assignment: Employee, worksite, start/end, task, team role, status, publication version, confirmation state, change history.
data_model_and_core_entities.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

data_model_and_core_entities.statement: AssignmentConfirmation: Scope (week or changed appointment), response, reason category, free text, respondent, timestamps.
data_model_and_core_entities.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

data_model_and_core_entities.statement: Absence: Employee, type, start/end, request status, visibility, approver, timestamps.
data_model_and_core_entities.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

data_model_and_core_entities.statement: Skill: Name, category, description, employee assignments, worksite requirements.
data_model_and_core_entities.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

data_model_and_core_entities.statement: Resource: Unique identity, category, attributes, status, availability, active damage state.
data_model_and_core_entities.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

data_model_and_core_entities.statement: ResourceReservation: Resource, worksite, start/end, state, conflict metadata.
data_model_and_core_entities.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

data_model_and_core_entities.statement: DamageReport: Resource, worksite, reporter, observed time, description, suspected sequence, type, area, severity, usability, state.
data_model_and_core_entities.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

data_model_and_core_entities.statement: Attachment: Object relation, type, size, storage key, uploader, timestamp, visibility, integrity metadata.
data_model_and_core_entities.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

data_model_and_core_entities.statement: TimeEntry: Employee, assignment, date, start/end, duration, state, original values, correction chain.
data_model_and_core_entities.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

data_model_and_core_entities.statement: TimeApproval: Time entry, reviewer, decision, reason, old/new values, timestamps.
data_model_and_core_entities.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

data_model_and_core_entities.statement: Notification: Recipient, channel, event type, object relation, delivery state, read state, timestamps.
data_model_and_core_entities.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

data_model_and_core_entities.statement: AuditRecord: Actor, action, object, old/new representation or diff, reason, timestamp, request correlation.
data_model_and_core_entities.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

data_model_and_core_entities.statement: SavedFilter: Owner, view type, permitted filter configuration, name, timestamps.
data_model_and_core_entities.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

data_model_and_core_entities.statement: PrivateRouteOrigin: Employee-owned encrypted or protected origin data, not exposed to coworkers or exports.
data_model_and_core_entities.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

data_model_and_core_entities.statement: WeatherSnapshot: normalized worksite coordinates/geohash, provider, forecast issue/fetch time, valid time, timezone, daypart, condition, temperature min/max, relative humidity min/max, precipitation probability maximum, precipitation amount sum, wind speed maximum, gust maximum, ozone maximum, source attribution, status, expiry, and cache metadata. It contains no employee device location.
data_model_and_core_entities.verification_method: Schema review and provider contract tests

data_model_and_core_entities.statement: OfficialWeatherWarning: source authority, CAP identifier, version/update identifier, event type, official severity/level, onset, expiry, affected geometry or administrative area, instruction text, source attribution, fetched-at time, cancellation/update relation, direct-site match, and nearby/regional match.
data_model_and_core_entities.verification_method: CAP fixture and lifecycle tests

data_model_and_core_entities.statement: EconomicRateVersion: subject type and ID, economic direction (cost or machine-rental revenue), unit (hour/day), net amount, currency EUR, valid-from, optional valid-to, status, creator, timestamps, and audit reference.
data_model_and_core_entities.verification_method: Stakeholder review and mapped acceptance test

data_model_and_core_entities.statement: PlannedEconomicSnapshot: selected planning version and period, source assignment/reservation IDs, rate-version IDs, quantities/durations, category totals, and generated-at timestamp. It is derived and rebuildable.
data_model_and_core_entities.verification_method: Stakeholder review and mapped acceptance test

data_model_and_core_entities.statement: ActualCostRecord: approved time-entry or confirmed resource-usage reference, effective rate-version reference, calculated net amount, calculation version, and audit link.
data_model_and_core_entities.verification_method: Stakeholder review and mapped acceptance test

data_model_and_core_entities.statement: MachineRentalRecord: rentable resource, rental interval, state (planned/confirmed/cancelled), effective rental-rate version, calculated net revenue, and audit links. It is not an invoice.
data_model_and_core_entities.verification_method: Stakeholder review and mapped acceptance test

api_interface_requirements.statement: Authentication and session API: Invite, activate, sign in, sign out, password reset, list/revoke sessions.
api_interface_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

api_interface_requirements.statement: Users, roles, and permissions API: CRUD with authorization, role preview, impact warning, and last-admin protection.
api_interface_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

api_interface_requirements.statement: Worksites and activities API: CRUD, required-field validation, activity catalog, notes, attachments, and archive.
api_interface_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

api_interface_requirements.statement: Assignments and planning API: Query calendars, create/move/swap assignments, validate conflicts, draft, publish, change versions.
api_interface_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

api_interface_requirements.statement: Confirmations API: Confirm week, reject appointment, reconfirm changed appointment, list pending/escalated responses.
api_interface_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

api_interface_requirements.statement: Absence API: Create request, approve/reject vacation, record sickness, query role-scoped availability.
api_interface_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

api_interface_requirements.statement: Skills API: Maintain catalog, assign employee skills, declare worksite requirements, compute gaps.
api_interface_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

api_interface_requirements.statement: Resources and reservations API: Maintain resources, reserve time ranges, block/release, and expose affected worksites.
api_interface_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

api_interface_requirements.statement: Damage API: Create report, upload evidence, update state, record release decision, retrieve audit trail.
api_interface_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

api_interface_requirements.statement: Time API: Start/stop timer, list own time, pending approvals, approve/correct/clarify.
api_interface_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

api_interface_requirements.statement: Notifications API: List/read in-app notifications and record delivery results; no email-side business response.
api_interface_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

api_interface_requirements.statement: File API: Issue protected upload/download operations with type, size, malware, and access validation.
api_interface_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

api_interface_requirements.statement: Routing adapter: Estimate route duration and produce external navigation link without exposing private origin.
api_interface_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

api_interface_requirements.statement: Transcription adapter: Submit audio, receive transcript, delete or retain audio according to policy, require user review.
api_interface_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

api_interface_requirements.statement: Export API: Generate role-filtered weekly PDF/print representation.
api_interface_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

api_interface_requirements.statement: Import API: Validate, preview, and commit bounded CSV imports with row-level error output.
api_interface_requirements.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

api_interface_requirements.statement: Forecast and air-quality adapter: Resolve current-day and next-day hourly forecast plus ozone for normalized worksite coordinates; normalize provider schemas into the internal WeatherSnapshot contract; expose freshness, units, attribution, provider errors, and quota state; support server-side caching and no per-user provider calls.
api_interface_requirements.verification_method: Contract, timeout, quota and cache tests

api_interface_requirements.statement: Official DWD warning adapter: Ingest DWD CAP/Open Data centrally, process updates and cancellations idempotently, and spatially associate warnings with worksite coordinates using warning geometry or municipality/district identifiers. Provider data is never fetched directly by mobile clients.
api_interface_requirements.verification_method: CAP fixture, spatial matching and idempotency tests

api_interface_requirements.statement: Economics rate administration API: authorized create/list/future-close/correct commands for individual effective-dated net rates, with overlap validation, idempotency, and audit.
api_interface_requirements.verification_method: Stakeholder review and mapped acceptance test

api_interface_requirements.statement: Economics calculation/report API: authorized planned-versus-actual cost queries by period and dimension, always returning applied rate-version IDs, source facts, net currency, and calculation timestamp.
api_interface_requirements.verification_method: Stakeholder review and mapped acceptance test

api_interface_requirements.statement: Machine-rental revenue API: authorized creation/confirmation/cancellation of rental intervals and net revenue queries, without invoice, tax, payment, or ledger side effects.
api_interface_requirements.verification_method: Stakeholder review and mapped acceptance test

architecture_constraints.statement: Domain independence: Domain rules must not depend on UI framework, HTTP controllers, database driver, email, maps, or transcription vendors.
architecture_constraints.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

architecture_constraints.statement: Module boundaries: Separate identity/access, planning, worksites, workforce, resources/damage, time, notifications, files, and reporting modules.
architecture_constraints.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

architecture_constraints.statement: Server-side authorization: Every protected query and mutation validates permission and object scope on the server.
architecture_constraints.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

architecture_constraints.statement: External ports: Email, routing, transcription, object storage, PDF generation, and monitoring are behind replaceable interfaces.
architecture_constraints.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

architecture_constraints.statement: Transactional publication: Plan publication, versioning, conflict validation, and confirmation requests use one consistent transaction or reliable outbox pattern.
architecture_constraints.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

architecture_constraints.statement: Idempotent commands: Publish, confirm, reject, start/stop timer, upload finalization, and notification jobs are idempotent.
architecture_constraints.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

architecture_constraints.statement: Read-only offline cache: Offline storage contains only authorized, previously loaded data and cannot mutate domain state.
architecture_constraints.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

architecture_constraints.statement: Append-only audit: Audit records cannot be modified or deleted by normal application workflows.
architecture_constraints.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

architecture_constraints.statement: Configuration boundary: Custom fields and catalogs extend predefined objects; they cannot create arbitrary executable workflows or bypass validation.
architecture_constraints.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

architecture_constraints.statement: Background job discipline: Reminder, escalation, email, transcription, export, and cleanup jobs specify retry limits, dead-letter behavior, and observability.
architecture_constraints.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

architecture_constraints.statement: Environment isolation: Development, test, and production use separate credentials, data stores, and storage buckets.
architecture_constraints.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

architecture_constraints.statement: ADR requirement: Hosting, database, object storage, email, maps, transcription, authentication, and observability choices require ADRs before implementation.
architecture_constraints.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

architecture_constraints.statement: Weather providers are accessed only through replaceable server-side adapters. Recommended MVP combination is OpenWeather One Call plus Air Pollution for forecast/ozone and DWD CAP Open Data as the authority for official German warnings. Domain and UI consume internal contracts; provider failure must not break assignment retrieval.
architecture_constraints.verification_method: ADR approval and architecture dependency tests

architecture_constraints.statement: Canonical repository: DYAI2025/Arborga is the only implementation repository. Documentation, ADRs, schema migrations, tests, application code, and deployment definitions are versioned there. The current default branch master should be renamed to main before implementation or explicitly retained through an ADR; no agent may assume the branch name.

Selected data platform: Supabase Postgres in Central EU (Frankfurt) is the database baseline. Recommended adjacent services are Supabase Auth and private Supabase Storage with Row Level Security, while service-role keys remain server-only. Database backup and object backup are separate because database backups do not restore deleted Storage objects.
architecture_constraints.verification_method: ADR, RLS tests, backup and restore tests

architecture_constraints.statement: Recommended runtime topology: a modular TypeScript mobile-first web/PWA application with server API/BFF plus a separate Python worker for local transcription and scheduled provider ingestion, deployed in a German EU region. Domain logic remains independent of Next.js/React, Supabase SDKs, workers, and provider adapters.
architecture_constraints.verification_method: Stack ADR and module dependency tests

architecture_constraints.statement: Post-MVP Economics is a separate bounded module that consumes approved Planning, Time, and Resource facts through owned interfaces. It must not become the system of record for payroll, invoicing, VAT, payments, or bookkeeping.
architecture_constraints.verification_method: Stakeholder review and mapped acceptance test

architecture_constraints.statement: Historical reproducibility: calculations bind to immutable rate-version IDs effective at the source interval. Changing a future rate creates a new version; backdated corrections require explicit authorization, audit, impact preview, and controlled recalculation.
architecture_constraints.verification_method: Stakeholder review and mapped acceptance test

security_privacy_and_compliance.statement: Credential security: Passwords are stored using an approved password-hashing mechanism; plaintext or reversible password storage is prohibited.

security_privacy_and_compliance.statement: Session control: Sessions are revocable, bounded in lifetime, protected against fixation, and invalidated for deactivated users.

security_privacy_and_compliance.statement: Authorization matrix: Permissions and object scope are enforced server-side; UI hiding is never treated as authorization.

security_privacy_and_compliance.statement: Sensitive permission warnings: Granting access to other employees, working times, absences, drafts, audit data, or device release requires explicit warning and audit.
security_privacy_and_compliance.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

security_privacy_and_compliance.statement: Private origin protection: Private route origins are not shown to coworkers, exports, logs, or general administrators without a separately justified permission.
security_privacy_and_compliance.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

security_privacy_and_compliance.statement: Absence minimization: Coworkers receive only relevant unavailability for overlapping work, never diagnoses or medical details.
security_privacy_and_compliance.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

security_privacy_and_compliance.statement: Upload controls: File type, size, content disposition, access, and malware risk are validated; direct public object URLs are prohibited.
security_privacy_and_compliance.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

security_privacy_and_compliance.statement: Audit protection: Audit data is append-only for normal users and includes correlation data without logging secrets or sensitive free text unnecessarily.
security_privacy_and_compliance.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

security_privacy_and_compliance.statement: Destructive controls: Deletion is replaced by deactivation/archive where historical planning, damage, time, or audit integrity is required.
security_privacy_and_compliance.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

security_privacy_and_compliance.statement: Release restriction: Only Administrator and Management can release blocked resources; action requires reason and reauthentication if risk level is high.
security_privacy_and_compliance.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

security_privacy_and_compliance.statement: Data encryption: Transport encryption is mandatory; provider-supported encryption at rest is required for database, files, backups, and private origins.
security_privacy_and_compliance.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

security_privacy_and_compliance.statement: Backup protection: Backups are access-controlled, encrypted, monitored, and restoration-tested.
security_privacy_and_compliance.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

security_privacy_and_compliance.statement: Vendor privacy: Email, maps, transcription, hosting, and storage providers require documented data flows and processing terms before production.
security_privacy_and_compliance.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

security_privacy_and_compliance.statement: No continuous tracking: The system must not collect continuous employee location, geofence events, or movement profiles.
security_privacy_and_compliance.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

security_privacy_and_compliance.statement: Human review: Permission templates, retention policy, production data flows, and safety-critical resource workflow receive human review before production.
security_privacy_and_compliance.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

security_privacy_and_compliance.statement: Supabase access control: Every exposed table and private Storage bucket uses explicit RLS policies. Authorization data is not trusted from user-editable metadata. Service-role credentials are never shipped to clients and are restricted to backend jobs with auditable purpose.
security_privacy_and_compliance.verification_method: RLS policy matrix and negative authorization tests

security_privacy_and_compliance.statement: Retention governance: Production requires a category-based deletion schedule approved by Arboscus and legal/data-protection review. The schedule follows storage limitation and necessity, documents start events, legal holds, backup expiry, and deletion evidence. DIN EN ISO/IEC 27555:2025-09 is used as a method framework, not as a source of fixed legal periods.
security_privacy_and_compliance.verification_method: Approved retention matrix and deletion-job evidence

security_privacy_and_compliance.statement: Voice privacy: Local transcription is recommended. Raw audio is private, not used to train external models, and is deleted after the user confirms the transcript or after a short configurable failure window. The transcript remains editable and must be confirmed before submission.
security_privacy_and_compliance.verification_method: Audio access, deletion and transcript-confirmation tests

security_privacy_and_compliance.statement: Commercial-data access: rate, cost, revenue, and economics-report endpoints enforce Administrator/Management access by default, explicit object scope, export authorization, and server-side denial for employees.

security_privacy_and_compliance.statement: Economics audit and minimization: individual rates are confidential commercial/personnel data; logs and analytics must not expose amounts unnecessarily, and rate changes/backdated corrections require actor, reason, previous/new version, and impact audit.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Given/When/Then: Given a draft plan, when an employee opens the app before publication, then the draft is invisible; after authorized publication it is visible.
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: Automated acceptance test and pilot review

acceptance_criteria.statement: Given/When/Then: Given a published week, when the employee confirms it, then all included assignments are accepted; a later material change reopens only that appointment.
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: Automated acceptance test and pilot review

acceptance_criteria.statement: Given/When/Then: Given an employee selects reject, when no category or free-text reason is provided, then submission is blocked; after submission authorized reviewers see the reason.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Given/When/Then: Given a relevant event, when processing completes, then an in-app notification and email delivery attempt exist and are traceable.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Given/When/Then: Given a regular employee attempts a global message, when the API receives it, then it is denied; Administrator or Management can send it.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Given/When/Then: Given a blocking conflict, when publication is requested, then it is rejected; warning-only conflicts remain visible and follow override policy.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Given/When/Then: Given a vacation request, when Administrator or Management approves it, then it becomes active and conflicts with overlapping assignments.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Given/When/Then: Given sickness is recorded, when calendar data is queried, then the employee is unavailable immediately and coworkers see no diagnosis.

risk_register.statement: Scope overload: The broad MVP can delay value. Mitigation: enforce incremental release gates and do not start extended functions before planning core passes pilot criteria. Severity: high.
risk_register.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

risk_register.statement: Low adoption: Employees may ignore the app or timer. Mitigation: prototype tests, immediate personal value, large actions, and measured pilot. Severity: high.
risk_register.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

risk_register.statement: Authorization leakage: Configurable roles can expose coworker, absence, time, or draft data. Mitigation: atomic permissions, warnings, server enforcement, role preview, tests. Severity: high.
risk_register.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

risk_register.statement: Safety-critical resource release: Improper release can affect safety and liability. Mitigation: restricted roles, reason, audit, reauthentication, human policy. Severity: high.
risk_register.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

risk_register.statement: Notification failure: Unseen plan changes recreate the original problem. Mitigation: reliable outbox, delivery status, retries, in-app state, escalation. Severity: high.
risk_register.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

risk_register.statement: Data privacy: Absence, home origin, time, photos, and audit data may be overexposed. Mitigation: minimization, scoped authorization, retention policy, encryption. Severity: high.
risk_register.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

risk_register.statement: Offline staleness: Employees may act on stale data. Mitigation: read-only cache, last-sync label, expiry, online refresh prompts. Severity: medium.
risk_register.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

risk_register.statement: Vendor dependency: Maps/transcription/email cost or outage may impair non-core features. Mitigation: ports, fallbacks, quotas, monitoring. Severity: medium.
risk_register.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

risk_register.statement: Configuration drift: Too many editable fields/statuses can break consistency. Mitigation: protected core semantics, validation, archive instead of destructive changes. Severity: medium.
risk_register.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

risk_register.statement: Migration quality: Bad CSV data can corrupt planning. Mitigation: preview, row validation, idempotent import, rollback batch. Severity: medium.
risk_register.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

risk_register.statement: Timer errors: Forgotten stop or concurrent timers produce bad records. Mitigation: single timer, ten-hour prompt, approval and corrections. Severity: medium.
risk_register.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

risk_register.statement: Legal retention uncertainty: Retention periods are not yet legally approved. Mitigation: production blocker and configurable retention after review. Severity: high.
risk_register.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

risk_register.statement: Stale or inaccurate weather may be interpreted as authoritative. Mitigation: show timestamp and source state, use bounded cache, keep assignment data independent, and treat weather as advisory until explicit warning or blocking rules are approved. Severity: high.

Warning freshness: A once-daily weather fetch is inadequate for rapidly changing thunderstorms and gust warnings. Mitigation: separate forecast cache from centrally polled official warnings, visible freshness, stale alerting, and no provider dependency in assignment retrieval. Severity: critical for safety communication, while the app remains advisory.

False regional precision: A point forecast or broad district warning may be mistaken for exact local certainty. Mitigation: distinguish forecast, direct official warning area, and nearby/regional context; display source, validity and uncertainty; do not invent probabilities absent from the provider. Severity: high.

Supabase backup gap: Database backups do not include Storage object bytes. Mitigation: independent encrypted object backup and restore test, plus documented RPO/RTO and deletion propagation. Severity: high.

Commercial confidentiality: individual employee/subcontractor rates and rental economics could be exposed. Mitigation: default Administrator/Management access, server authorization, export control, redaction, and tests. Severity: high.
risk_register.verification_method: Stakeholder review and mapped acceptance test

risk_register.statement: Historical drift: overwriting rates or recalculating history with current rates would corrupt comparisons. Mitigation: effective-dated immutable versions, applied-rate references, correction workflow, and reproducibility tests. Severity: high.
risk_register.verification_method: Stakeholder review and mapped acceptance test

risk_register.statement: Accounting scope creep: internal overview may be mistaken for payroll, invoice, tax, or bookkeeping output. Mitigation: explicit net/non-accounting labels, no VAT/gross/payment/ledger fields, separate system-of-record boundary, and UI/export disclaimers. Severity: high.
risk_register.verification_method: Stakeholder review and mapped acceptance test

findings.claim: The canonical repository and database platform are now selected, but runtime, email, hosting, backup, and provider ADRs remain partially unresolved.
findings.impact: Implementation can begin with documentation/ADR and scaffold work but production-grade coding should not assume unapproved providers or branch conventions.
findings.recommendation: Use DYAI2025/Arborga only, decide master-to-main policy, adopt Supabase Frankfurt, and approve the recommended modular runtime/provider package before Phase 2.

findings.claim: Retention and deletion periods require legal and organizational review before production.
findings.impact: Unbounded retention creates privacy and operational risk.
findings.recommendation: Treat approved retention schedule as production release gate.

findings.claim: The supplementary MVP target does not override the approved PRD; compatible employee-lifecycle and pilot-scale precision can be added without removing broader approved scope.
findings.impact: The PRD remains the single source of truth while useful supplementary detail improves testability.
findings.recommendation: Keep the approved PRD scope and label supplementary values as acceptance scenarios rather than maxima.

findings.claim: A once-daily forecast refresh does not satisfy the requirement to surface newly issued thunderstorms and strong-gust warnings for tree-climbing work.
findings.impact: A new official warning could remain invisible during a workday if forecast and warning ingestion are treated as one daily call.
findings.recommendation: Separate cached forecast/ozone calls from a centrally polled DWD CAP warning feed; poll official warnings every ten minutes and mark stale after twenty minutes. Keep the feature advisory and highly visible.

findings.claim: Assignment-based weather does not require employee tracking.
findings.impact: Implementing device-location tracking would contradict the approved non-goals and add unnecessary employee privacy risk.
findings.recommendation: Store geocoded worksite coordinates and derive access from assignment visibility; do not request background or continuous employee location.

findings.claim: There is no single German or EU default retention duration for every Arboscus data category.
findings.impact: Applying one blanket period can either over-retain sensitive employee data or delete evidence too early.
findings.recommendation: Use DIN EN ISO/IEC 27555 as the deletion-method framework and approve a category matrix; treat only explicit legal periods as hard minimums.

findings.claim: The requested economics capability is valuable but would materially expand the MVP and create confidential commercial-data and accounting-boundary risks.
findings.impact: Implementing it now could delay the planning core and blur the boundary to payroll, invoicing, VAT, and bookkeeping.
findings.recommendation: Keep it as a fully specified post-MVP Jira epic behind a separate phase and feature flag; implement only internal net planning/actual cost and machine-rental revenue views.

authentication.statement: Use invite-based accounts, secure password hashing, reset tokens, revocable sessions, and deactivation enforcement.
authentication.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

authorization.statement: Authorization is enforced server-side and with Supabase RLS defense in depth. Weather reads require a visible assignment or an explicitly granted planner permission; no weather endpoint accepts arbitrary employee location.
Post-MVP economics endpoints and reports default to Administrator/Management only; Employee is denied even if UI routes are guessed directly.
authorization.verification_method: Stakeholder review and mapped acceptance test

secrets_management.statement: Store application, database, email, routing, transcription, and storage secrets only in environment secret management; never in repository, client, logs, or exports.
secrets_management.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

logging_and_redaction.statement: Use structured audit and operational logs with correlation IDs; redact passwords, tokens, private origins, medical detail, voice content, and sensitive free text.
logging_and_redaction.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

logging_and_redaction.statement: Confidential individual rates and amounts are not included in routine telemetry, client logs, notifications, or support traces. Audit identifies rate versions and changes with least necessary values.
logging_and_redaction.verification_method: Stakeholder review and mapped acceptance test

data_protection.statement: Use Supabase Central EU (Frankfurt), private Storage buckets, encrypted transport, minimal fields, category-based retention, independent object backups, and no continuous employee GPS. Provider data flows and DPAs are approved before production.

abuse_cases.statement: Test role escalation, direct-object access, mass data export, abusive global messages, forged confirmations, unauthorized release, malicious uploads, timer manipulation, and origin leakage.
abuse_cases.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

destructive_action_controls.statement: Prefer deactivate/archive; require confirmations and audit for role changes, resource release, time corrections, imports, and other high-impact actions.
destructive_action_controls.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

security_tests.statement: Run automated auth/authz, session, upload, injection, rate-limit, CSRF where applicable, log-redaction, and dependency security tests before pilot and release.
security_tests.verification_method: Review against source and mapped acceptance test

privacy_controls.statement: Raw audio is short-lived and local transcription is preferred; illness diagnosis is not stored; private route origin is isolated; weather uses worksite coordinates only; logs redact names, free text, coordinates where unnecessary, audio URLs, tokens, and provider keys.

human_review_checkpoints.statement: Human approval is required for stack/provider ADRs, RLS matrix, retention schedule, warning communication channels, pilot targets, backup restore, real-data pilot, and production release.
Human approval is required before enabling PHASE-007, changing economics permissions, performing a backdated rate correction, or releasing economics reports/exports to another role.
human_review_checkpoints.verification_method: Stakeholder review and mapped acceptance test

agent_handoff.objective: Implement the Arboscus Teamplaner only in DYAI2025/Arborga, starting with ADRs and preserving the approved product, authorization, privacy, weather-warning, traceability, and release rules.

prohibited_actions: Do not bypass API authorization or Supabase RLS.
Do not use employee GPS/background tracking for weather.
Do not make provider calls directly from mobile clients or once per employee.
Do not treat forecast data as an official warning.
Do not automatically cancel work, block publication, or issue a binding stop-work decision from weather in MVP.
Do not expose Supabase service-role, weather, routing, email, or monitoring keys to clients.
Do not add a provider, background job, destructive migration, or retention period without an approved ADR/policy.
Do not log illness details, private route origins, audio, sensitive free text, precise coordinates where unnecessary, or credentials.
Do not implement the post-MVP Planning Economics and Machine Rental capability during MVP phases.
Do not add payroll, invoicing, VAT/gross, payment, ledger, tax, or unrelated revenue functionality.
